title: Specified scalar pullback comparison and curried intrinsic tensor map
statement: For a finite commutative ring R and scheme morphism p:X→Y, form the inverse mate alpha:EY ⋙ Lp_intrinsic* ≅ Lp_fixed* ⋙ EX of the normalized derived direct-image comparison of the specified scalar realization [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image]. The sectionwise coefficient Hom bijection identifies the two intrinsic direct-image presentations. The inverse mate is invertible along the two realization equivalences [lem-stage3-inverse-mate-equivalences]. For given representative-normalized tensor models aX and aY, curry their canonical intrinsic tensor-pullback comparison [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-tensor-pullback]. These are precisely the original finiteScalarPullbackComparison and finiteScalarCurriedTensorPullback definitions, with unchanged bodies.

source.place: Tag 07A6, uniqueness of adjoints; Tag 07A4, tensor-pullback comparison

proof.text: Apply the coefficient adjunction Hom bijection and its inverse to identify the coefficient maps and hence the direct-image functors. Compose the normalized derived comparison with this functor identity and take its inverse mate.
Curry the canonical intrinsic tensor-pullback comparison and compose with the standard product-composition isomorphism.

        proEtaleConstantRingDerivedPullback R p ≅
      (ProEtale.upperStar
        (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} R)) p).leftDerivedFunctor ⋙
